sql: select fish_date_season s, floor(fish_date_doy/10)*10 b, cls, round(sum(yt)/sum(anglers),2) r, count(*) n from trips where cls in ('overnight','day_1_5','three_quarter') and fish_date_doy between 210 and 300 and (fish_date_season=1 or fish_date_doy between 240 and 280) group by all order by s,b,cls

summary: 3/4-day gate 0.3->0.5 and reserve $1200->$550 (0 after doy 262): 3/4 boats at 1.6 yt/angler for $150 are the best fish per dollar now.
